purpose: Teach: 硫黄/料亭/銅像/寒天/紋章/紫色/食肉/露店

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと硫黄温泉に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go see the sulfur hot springs with Dad?
lines.style: Soft, inviting tone. Gentle lilt on the suggestion. Warm and patient—the voice of someone creating a moment. No pressure, only possibility.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが料亭に予約してくれたんだって
lines.en: Mom, Dad made a reservation at a nice restaurant for us.
lines.style: Bright and eager, but grounded—not performed excitement. Small voice building as he shares what he learned. Genuine pleasure at having news to tell.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと公園の銅像を見に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, shall we go see the bronze statue in the park with Dad?
lines.style: Same gentle warmth as before. Steady, unhurried. Offering another small adventure the way a mother collects them for her child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの寒天デザート楽しみ
lines.en: Mom, I'm really looking forward to Grandma's agar dessert.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. A small, genuine smile in the voice. He's thinking ahead to something that makes him happy, speaking without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家の紋章を教えてあげるわね
lines.en: Sho, I'll tell you about our family crest.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact kindness. A small shift—she's offering him something of substance, not just an outing. Slight formality beneath the warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、紫色の靴下欲しい
lines.style: Direct and simple. A small request without apology. The clarity of childhood wanting something specific. Honest and unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お肉だけでなく野菜も食べましょうね、食肉に偏らないでね
lines.en: Sho, let's eat vegetables too, not just meat—we need a balanced diet.
lines.style: Gentle guidance without harshness. The tone shifts to practical mother—still warm, but with a quiet firmness underneath. Light touch on the importance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祭りの露店で綿菓子買ってもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad bought me cotton candy at the festival stall.
lines.style: Warm recollection, tinged with delight. He's sharing a happy memory, small voice proud. The contentment of a child who was treated well.
